text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone from the Kokura shopping arcade...
is here to watch today...?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it super far from Kokura?
Why go that far...?"
choice_data_list: Because she's someone you just can't help but cheer for.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
Saying such embarrassing things again...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's true that
people are cheering for me, right?”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...I can't afford to lose.
It's thanks to everyone's support that I'm standing on this stage, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No matter how strong my opponents are...
I have to do my best.

Mejiro McQueen and Mejiro Ryan.
Nice Nature's eyes are surely reflecting them right now.

Having gained a new rival,
Nice Nature is... on fire!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to look uncool
in front of everyone.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Just like they're strong,
I can... run, too!
choice_data_list: Go and run with everything you've got!
Go run with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ――Aiming for 1st place, with everything I've got!
